label: PF Backlog 147
title: Single-run guard: stop the running instance before start/restart/resume/continue
body: New core/run_guard.py — on any start it cleans stale locks, asks a live instance to STOP (control.json channel honored by stage_runner), waits, force-terminates if needed, then acquires the lock. Wired into scripts/run_pipeline.py (no longer aborts on a live run; it stops it first). Prevents nuisance duplicate instances.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend/infra change; dashboard reads the new index as data only.
